HIGHEST PRIORITY: Draw Kaname Rana's FACE STRAIGHT UPRIGHT, front-facing, facial midline exactly vertical. The centers of BOTH EYES must sit on ONE HORIZONTAL LINE at the SAME Y coordinate, both cheeks at the same height. The attached reference head is diagonal: DO NOT COPY THAT TILT. The body hangs downward; do not rotate a horizontal sprite. SECOND IDENTITY PRIORITY: Rana's OWN RIGHT eye is GOLD and her OWN LEFT eye is BLUE. In this unmirrored frontal drawing, VIEWER-LEFT eye = GOLD; VIEWER-RIGHT eye = BLUE. Do not average the colors and do not mirror them.

Create one original transparent vertical edge companion: MyGO!!!!! Kaname Rana as a sparse 2D human-cartoon head integrated with a COMPLETE WHITE meme-cat body. The accepted Sakiko reference supplies only the family simplicity, line weight, head-to-body weight and vertical clasping paw/body relationship. No Sakiko hair color, gold-gold eyes, ribbons or face reused. Build an individual Rana head from soft layered SILVER-WHITE short hair, a few broad gray-shadow fringe groups and rounded jaw-to-nape cheek locks, recognizable two-color round eyes. No hair bow, no human clothing, no uniform, no socks, no collar. The cat ears behind the hair are part of this project's original cat anatomy, not an asserted official accessory.

She has her own little reason for being here. She had climbed toward an edge that made an interesting small tapping resonance. The familiar person changes the rhythm, and she stops moving because that alteration has actually caught her interest. She looks level outward toward that person, attentive and quietly curious, not sleepy and not offering routine reassurance. Her eyebrows are almost level with one very small lift of alert attention. Keep a tiny CLOSED short mouth, slightly off-center as though she is considering whether to try the rhythm again, not a w-shaped cat smile and not an open baby mouth. Her paw contact remains steady while attention changes first; the body's stillness belongs to her chosen interest, not listlessness. Nothing needs to be drawn to stand for the sound; no music notes, symbols, instrument, text or speech bubble.

Use the approved family's very simple white face, clean dark navy outline, round irises with only TWO FLAT COLOR ZONES each: gold above pale gold in viewer-left eye, muted blue above pale blue in viewer-right eye. No pupils as black glass, no gradient highlights, no sparkle, no blush, no skin color, no photorealistic fur, no 3D or plush rendering, no mature makeup. Hair, head, body and paws must feel drawn together by the same sparse 2D pen. White hair needs a few flat pale-gray divisions to remain legible against the white face; do not overdetail it.

Complete vertical anatomy and support: head above a compact white torso on the LEFT of an imagined vertical edge at roughly 82 percent of canvas width. This edge is NOT DRAWN. Two naturally attached front paws curl RIGHT round that same unseen edge, one beside lower cheek and one beside upper belly. Their outward contact tips align to one near-vertical x coordinate. A visible bent hind leg and hind paw lower down brace the same side. No loose, extra, hidden-by-mistake or disconnected paws. Abdomen hangs down, not a sideways loaf. Tail grows continuously from lower rump, descends and bends softly down-left in one simple curve, whole tip visible. Eye line stays horizontal even if body curves a little. Leave generous transparent clearance around head/ears/paws/tail.

Portrait composition, whole character uncut. Simple two-zone silver-gray hair and flat white body. Absolutely NO panel, ledge, visible vertical line, ruler, rectangle, background, floor, cast shadow, glow, colored halo or translucent fog. Genuine RGBA transparency immediately beyond the narrow normal antialiased contour. No UI, watermarks, borders or collage. This is an independently generated original vertical drawing for later optional rigging; raw global mirroring is never accepted for this character's eye identity.
